latestVersion.changelog:
amazon-to-shopify-sync 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Extracts product data from Amazon (supports multiple languages).
- Auto-rewrites French content into high-conversion English for Shopify listings.
- Syncs products to Shopify using REST Admin API with automatic token renewal.
- Designed to work with dinoho.myshopify.com authentication and dinoho.cn data endpoints.
